key_insight: SCoRE improves visual RAG by explicitly selecting and consolidating query-relevant images before answering, reducing noise from exploratory agent trajectories and strengthening visual grounding.
engineering_relevance: For document QA and enterprise search systems, the method offers a practical way to keep visual context bounded while preserving traceable evidence links for more reliable answers.
method: Maintains a textual ledger of only query-relevant observations plus source pointers during exploration.
At termination, reloads the referenced original page images and consolidates them into a logical evidence sequence for answer generation.
Trains end-to-end with cold-start trajectory distillation and evidence-aware reinforcement learning to reward coverage, compactness, and correctness.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports optimization objectives and a unified rollout training setup, but does not provide specific dataset names or quantitative results.
watch_item: Performance depends on accurate source-pointer tracking and faithful reloading of original images, so indexing or retrieval errors could break grounding.
paper_title: Navigating Sparse Evidence: Agentic Visual RAG via Explicit Context Selection and Consolidation
